jobsdetail.description:
Description
Clicker is a protocol by Daylight, a USV- and 1kx-backed startup.
Problem
The core problem in trading is discovery: what should I buy and why?
Many people track other traders' trades to solve the “what”, but they never get the “why”.

Solution
Clicker is the global trade comment network: trade wherever, comment with why you made the trade, and see other traders’ trade comments.
Commenters and Clicker earn a % of the copytrades that comments drive across trading apps.
Apps get access to trade comments from traders in other apps and can give their users’ comments much greater reach than just their own app.

Why Now?

Trading apps like Coinbase Wallet and Phantom are going social (necessary foundation for Clicker).
CEXs (Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, etc) and fintechs (Robinhood) are all adding DEX trading to their CEX apps (huge TAM increase for Clicker).
New trading formats are getting traction: prediction markets, perps, tokenized stocks (huge content increase for Clicker).

How It Works
Trade in any app.
Comment on your trade in any integrated app (or in the Clicker mobile app in the beginning).
Earn on any copytrades your comments drive across Clicker-integrated apps.
Follow good traders and copy their trade comments.
Our mobile app lets you comment on all your trades (whether or not your preferred trading client has integrated Clicker), see the trade comments and trades of the addresses you follow, and discover good traders to follow.
We are looking for a staff backend engineer with deep experience designing and scaling REST APIs. Our API serves tens of thousands of requests per second, summarizing millions of rows of offchain data and terabytes of onchain data in 500ms or less.
The problems we work on are meat-and-potatoes software engineering: writing code understandable to others; optimizing Postgresql queries; tracing code paths for bottlenecks; getting the most out of AWS infrastructure.

Responsibilities:

Build clean, maintainable, and well-tested backend code
Collaborate with product to define, prioritize, and build
Design backend REST APIs for usability and for scale
Projects you may work on:
Feed: rapid, pre-built, algo-sorted feed of trades from people you follow
Discovery: surfacing good traders to follow across a diverse set of metrics
Trading Metrics: large scale onchain metrics (PnL, win rate, etc) aggregation
Trade Comments: prioritizing good comment creators across our products and partners
Protocol: improvements to the Clicker rewards contracts and indexers
Generally build the Clicker API - a robust, scalable, and developer-friendly API that the biggest crypto apps will use
jobsdetail.requirement:
You have:

Deep experience with modern backend technologies like Node.js, Typescript, AWS, and Postgres
5+ years at tech startups with millions of DAUs
Appetite to work on complex products with autonomy and creative freedom
Experience designing and building out programmatic APIs
Experience maintaining highly available infrastructure

jobsdetail.benefits:
What is Hyli

Hyli is a next-generation base layer for a post-proof world. It’s an opinionated layer-1 blockchain built around the affordances of proofs. Hyli is built to unlock what proofs make possible: customizability, scalability, and privacy.

Hyli combines native proof verification embedded directly into the protocol with a fast data dissemination and data availability layer powered by the Autobahn consensus algorithm.

Computation must be verifiable, so we enshrined proof verification into the protocol and made it effortless to compose different proofs.

Proofs introduce latency and overhead, so we invented pipelined proving to remove this bottleneck.

The future runs on appchains, so everything on Hyli is an appchain by default: apps sequence on Hyli and update their state with a corresponding proof.

Hyli is:

Highly simple: no execution environment, no native runtime. Just proofs and data.

Highly efficient: leveraging the latest in consensus design (Autobahn) and proof systems (Risc0, SP1, Noir, etc.).

Highly usable: identity and access flows powered by existing user credentials (email, wallets, credentials) and signed data (passports).

Highly orange.

Fueled by a $3.4M investment from top-tier venture capitalists, our team is led by our founders Sylve (CEO) and Lancelot (CTO).

The team

We are currently a team of 8, including five developers.

You will work alongside the business team: Sylve (CEO), Cécile (Chief of Staff), Alex S. (Head of Content) and Matteo (Discovery team).

Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet: A multi-currency wallet that gives users full control over their private keys and digital assets.

Integrated Banking Services: Each account includes a European IBAN, a physical or virtual debit card, and instant SEPA transfers.

Seamless Crypto-to-Fiat Exchange: Users can easily convert cryptocurrencies to fiat and vice-versa directly within the app, which is a key differentiator from many traditional crypto exchanges.

Yield on Digital Assets: The platform provides opportunities to earn a competitive yield (up to 10%) on assets held in vaults.

Business Accounts: For businesses, DeBlock offers accounts with multi-signature wallets to enhance security and control over corporate funds.

The Team
The company was founded by a leadership team with deep experience in both traditional fintech and crypto:

Jean Meyer, CEO and Co-Founder (ex-Revolut Crypto Chief)

Aaron Beck, Co-Founder (ex-Revolut Payment Chief)

Funding

This funding demonstrates strong investor confidence in Deblock's business model and vision.

Company Culture and Work Environment
Deblock is a dynamic and globally diverse company with over 60 employees from 12 different countries. They've built a culture that values flexibility and talent, offering a number of benefits:

Remote-First: The company operates on a 100% remote basis.

Flexibility: Employees have the option to work abroad for up to four months per year.

Description
Gauntlet leads the field in quantitative research and optimization of DeFi economics. We manage market risk, optimize growth, and ensure economic safety for protocols facilitating most spot trading, borrowing, and lending activity across all of DeFi, protecting and optimizing the largest protocols and networks in the industry. As of April 2025, Gauntlet manages risk and incentives covering over $42 billion in customer TVL.

Gauntlet continually publishes cutting-edge research that informs our risk models, alerts, and analysis, and is among the most cited institution — including academic institutions — in terms of peer-reviewed papers addressing DeFi as a subject. We’re a Series B company with around 75 employees, operating remote-first with a home base in New York City.

Gauntlet’s mission is to drive adoption and understanding in the financial systems of the future. Building with decentralized systems creates novel challenges for mechanism designers, smart contract developers, and end-users of financial products, which are not seen in traditional software development and investing contexts. Gauntlet is dedicated to enhancing our industry’s understanding of this new domain and revealing how to safely navigate the true bleeding edge of 21st-century financial innovation.

Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software issues to maintain system reliability and performance

About Deblock
Deblock is a London-based fintech company founded in 2022 that's building a financial platform to bridge the gap between traditional banking and decentralized finance. Their core mission is to give users complete ownership and control of their money and digital assets through a secure, self-custodial approach. Unlike many traditional fintech or crypto apps, DeBlock is regulated by the ACPR (Banque de France) and the AMF (Financial Markets Authority), providing a high level of credibility and security.

What They Do
Deblock offers an integrated financial platform that combines the best of both traditional and decentralized finance. The service provides users with:
Non-Custodial Crypto Wallet: A multi-currency wallet that gives users full control over their private keys and digital assets.
Integrated Banking Services: Each account includes a European IBAN, a physical or virtual debit card, and instant SEPA transfers.
Seamless Crypto-to-Fiat Exchange: Users can easily convert cryptocurrencies to fiat and vice-versa directly within the app, which is a key differentiator from many traditional crypto exchanges.
Yield on Digital Assets: The platform provides opportunities to earn a competitive yield (up to 10%) on assets held in vaults.
Business Accounts: For businesses, DeBlock offers accounts with multi-signature wallets to enhance security and control over corporate funds.

The Team
The company was founded by a leadership team with deep experience in both traditional fintech and crypto:
Jean Meyer, CEO and Co-Founder (ex-Revolut Crypto Chief)
Aaron Beck, Co-Founder (ex-Revolut Payment Chief)
Mario Eguiliuz, Co-Founder (ex-Ledger Engineering Chief)
Adriana Restrepo, COO (Ex Revolut COO)
The team's background at major players like Revolut and Ledger highlights their expertise in building scalable, secure, and user-friendly financial products.

Funding
Deblock has successfully raised a total of $26.1 million in seed funding across several rounds. A significant portion of this funding, a $14.3 million round in November 2024, was led by prominent venture capital firms including Headline, Hoxton Ventures, and 20VC. This funding demonstrates strong investor confidence in Deblock's business model and vision.

Company Culture and Work Environment
Deblock is a dynamic and globally diverse company with over 60 employees from 12 different countries. They've built a culture that values flexibility and talent, offering a number of benefits:
Remote-First: The company operates on a 100% remote basis.
Flexibility: Employees have the option to work abroad for up to four months per year.
Generous Leave: The company provides 30 days of annual leave.
Competitive Compensation: Compensation is structured to be in the top 1% for the European market.
Additional Benefits: Private health insurance is provided for all employees.

jobsdetail.description:
Gauntlet is the industry leader in quantitative research and optimization for DeFi economics. We manage market risk, accelerate protocol growth, and ensure economic safety for platforms that facilitate the majority of spot trading, borrowing, and lending activity across the entire DeFi ecosystem. Our work protects and optimizes the largest protocols and blockchain networks in the industry.

We also build institutional-grade DeFi vaults that deliver scalable, risk-adjusted on-chain yields — designed by some of the most rigorous quantitative minds in crypto and backed by years of research. As of April 2025, Gauntlet oversees risk and incentive programs supporting more than $42 billion in customer TVL.

Gauntlet publishes cutting-edge research that powers our risk models, alerts, and analyses, and we are among the most cited organizations — including academic institutions — in peer-reviewed DeFi research. We are a Series B company with roughly 75 employees, operating remote-first with a home base in New York City.

To expand our impact in the DeFi space, we are seeking experienced Data Scientists to help both new and established protocols better understand and optimize the systems they’ve built. This role requires strong analytical and interpretive capabilities, as well as the ability to collaborate with and manage external clients. You will work directly with leading, innovative DeFi protocols and develop deep expertise in the mechanisms that power the industry.

Responsibilities

  1. Conduct in-depth, novel research to improve the safety and efficiency of premier DeFi protocols through mechanism design, data analysis, and dynamic parameter optimization.
  2. Take full ownership of client engagements — including scoping work, managing relationships, and delivering impactful research and insights.
  3. Draft and publish high-quality research for public audiences to strengthen Gauntlet’s brand and fulfill client needs.
  4. Build and deploy clear, intuitive, and visually compelling dashboards for both internal and external stakeholders.

  5. Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), and/or statistical or mathematical tools (e.g., R).
  6. Ability to work autonomously and make progress toward abstract or open-ended goals.
  7. Experience with pricing models, financial products, and/or multiple asset classes.

Bonus Points

  2. Previous experience managing external client relationships.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter / HR Call
  2. Important: Candidates should thoroughly research Gauntlet before the call — including research publications, blog posts, forum communications, protocol partnerships, vault products, and recent updates. Gauntlet expects candidates to come fully prepared.

Recruiting Tips (Important!)

Gauntlet strongly prefers being introduced to candidates they have never engaged with before.

When screening, always verify whether the candidate has previously applied or interviewed with Gauntlet.

About Gauntlet

Institutional-grade vaults for decentralized finance

Gauntlet develops institutional-scale vaults that generate risk-adjusted DeFi yields. These strategies are powered by our automated risk platform, designed by leading quantitative experts in crypto. We continuously monitor market conditions to capture growth opportunities while protecting self-custodial capital and minimizing downside exposure.

Applied Research & Protocol Optimization

Our Applied Research team transforms cutting-edge DeFi research into actionable strategies that improve protocol efficiency, mitigate risk, and support sustainable ecosystem growth. Through rigorous data analysis, simulation modeling, and economic design principles, we help both early-stage networks and established ecosystems scale with confidence.

By combining deep expertise in cryptoeconomics, mechanism design, and traditional finance, Gauntlet delivers data-driven recommendations and systems that reduce systemic risk, enhance protocol stability, and accelerate long-term growth.

Description

About Uniform Labs


We are an on-chain financial infrastructure company backed by leading VCs including Strobe Fund, CMT Digital, Metalayer VC, The Venture Dept, and Generative Ventures. We're upgrading financial markets through 24/7 instant settlement. Our first product is Multiliquid, an institutional-grade smart contract protocol that facilitates interoperability and liquidity across tokenized financial assets and stablecoins. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance (TradFi) assets and decentralised finance (DeFi) in a transparent, efficient, and highly scalable way, ultimately replatforming all of financial markets on 10x better infrastructure in the form of blockchain.


Role Overview


We're looking for a Smart Contract Developer to join our core engineering team. In this hands-on role, you'll design, develop, and deploy secure smart contracts that power the Multiliquid protocol. You'll architect on-chain logic, optimize gas efficiency, ensure security best practices, and build the foundational infrastructure that enables institutional-grade DeFi operations. This is an opportunity to shape the core protocol layer of institutional DeFi, building robust, auditable smart contracts that handle significant liquidity flows across multiple chains.


You will work on a small, rigorously selected, senior team of engineers. You will be responsible for collaborating closely with product, compliance, security auditors, and business stakeholders. This is a high-impact role requiring deep technical expertise in blockchain development, strong security mindset, strategic thinking, and a passion for delivering best-in-class DeFi solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Smart Contract Development

Design, develop, test, and deploy secure smart contracts in Solidity for the Multiliquid protocol using Foundry.

Implement complex DeFi primitives including liquidity pools, cross-chain bridges, access control mechanisms, and institutional-grade financial logic.

Write clean, well-documented, gas-optimized code that adheres to industry best practices and established design patterns.


Protocol Architecture

Architect scalable, modular smart contract systems that support evolving protocol requirements.

Design upgradeable contract patterns and governance mechanisms for protocol evolution.

Collaborate with the engineering team to define on-chain/off-chain boundaries and integration points.


Security & Auditing

Conduct thorough internal security reviews and testing of smart contracts before deployment.

Work closely with external auditors to address findings and implement recommended security improvements.

Proactively identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and edge cases.

Stay current with emerging security threats and best practices in the DeFi ecosystem.


Testing & Quality Assurance

Write comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and fuzzing tests for all smart contract code.

Develop test suites that cover edge cases, failure scenarios, and adversarial conditions.

Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to maintain high code quality standards.


Cross-Chain & Integration Work

Implement cross-chain messaging protocols and bridge integrations to enable multi-chain liquidity flows.

Collaborate with full-stack engineers to ensure seamless integration between smart contracts and front-end/back-end systems.

Design and document contract interfaces (ABIs) that enable efficient off-chain interaction.


Hands-On Engineering

Actively write and deploy smart contract code to mainnet and testnets.

Lead the development of core protocol features and upgrades.

Monitor deployed contracts, respond to on-chain events, and troubleshoot issues in production environments.

Prototype, iterate, and optimize rapidly in a fast-moving environment.

We’re Baton Corporation, a team of elite builders moving fast and redefining what’s possible.

What You’ll Do


As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design and scale the fintech and crypto systems powering seamless fiat ↔ crypto flows, real-time risk decisions, and rock-solid financial records.


You will:


  1. Own payment orchestration for bank rails (ACH, RTP, FedNow, SEPA, Open Banking) and cards (Apple Pay, Google Pay) with idempotent, fault-tolerant APIs and webhook processing.
  2. Integrate third-party providers (Plaid, TrueLayer, Tink, Stripe, Checkout.com, Adyen, Chainalysis, TRM, Travel Rule networks) behind clean, reliable interfaces.

  7. Raise the bar on reliability — SLOs, circuit breakers, retries, DLQs, shadow traffic, and canary releases.
  8. Instrument everything with traces, metrics, and logs. Build internal ops & compliance dashboards and participate in on-call for a 24/7 system.
  9. Collaborate cross-functionally with product, mobile, compliance, risk, and finance to take features from concept to production.

Description

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol that recently secured $50 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, a16z crypto, Coinbase Ventures, Variant, Brevan Howard, Pantera, Blocktower, and 50 others to support its mission of revolutionizing lending with an open, efficient, and resilient platform. Paris or remote (from GMT -5 up to GMT +2 to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).


Mission & Responsibilities

We’re looking for a Product Lead to drive Morpho’s Prime Products vertical.


You’ll work with engineering, design, data and protocol teams to set strategy, ship industry-shaping products and help Curators and Advanced Users interact with Morpho’s protocol.

To do so, you will need to develop a deep understanding of Morpho’s protocol and products, various stakeholders, the market, competitors and the wider Defi and lending industry as a whole.


Specifically, you will:

Understand Morpho’s various stakeholders, their needs and requirements,

Deeply understand the wider crypto lending space, both Centralized and Decentralized,

Execute on the product vision and strategy with a world-class engineering team,

Shape the products that Curators, Institutions and Pro users use to manage risk and exposure.

About Morpho Labs

Overview and Mission

Morpho Labs is the development company behind Morpho, a leading decentralized lending protocol. Its mission is to make financial infrastructure a public good by providing an open, efficient, and resilient platform for on-chain loans. Morpho enables anyone to earn yield or borrow crypto assets permissionlessly, while also allowing developers and businesses to build custom lending markets and vaults on its infrastructure.


Since launch, Morpho has grown into one of the largest DeFi lending systems (≈$6 B in deposits as of mid-2025) operating on Ethereum and other chains. Its vision is to become a cornerstone of a new internet-native financial system by fusing DeFi lending with traditional fintech.


Product Offerings

Morpho offers a suite of lending/borrowing products and developer tools built around its smart-contract protocol:


Consumer Products (Earn/Borrow):

Retail users can deposit assets into Morpho Vaults to earn optimized interest, or post collateral to borrow other tokens. Morpho optimizes yields by peer-to-peer matching within its vaults on top of base pools like Aave/Compound. Borrowers enjoy higher collateral limits and no protocol fees.


Curate/Vaults (Prime):

Power users and institutions can deploy custom vaults and lending markets. The Curate interface lets “vault curators” configure collateral types, interest models, and risk parameters, earning fees for supplying liquidity. These vaults are open, customizable, and scalable, benefiting from Morpho’s liquidity and matching engine. This is powered by the “Morpho Blue” protocol — a minimal core lending engine designed for security and flexibility.


Developer Tools (Infra):

Morpho provides on-chain and off-chain infrastructure for developers. A public GraphQL API and SDK libraries let applications query Morpho data and integrate lending functions. Enterprises can build their own lending use cases on Morpho’s stack, benefitting from audited, formally-verified contracts and DevOps tools.


Morpho infrastructure underpins notable integrations — for example, Coinbase’s on-chain lending launched in early 2025 uses Morpho on the Base chain to offer crypto-backed loans through the Coinbase app.


Funding History

Morpho Labs has raised approximately $70 M in venture funding (mostly through token sales):

Seed Round (Oct 2021): ~$1.35 M, led by Semantic Ventures and Nascent

Strategic Round (July 2022): $18 M, co-led by a16z Crypto and Variant

Strategic Round (Aug 2024): $50 M, led by Ribbit Capital with a16z, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera, Brevan Howard, BlockTower, Kraken Ventures, and others

These funds are supporting growth on Ethereum and expansion to new chains.


Team Structure and Leadership

Morpho Labs is structured with both for-profit and nonprofit entities, but engineering is centralized under the development company.

The engineering organization is divided into smart-contract and off-chain teams. Core protocol development is handled by a small group focused on Morpho Blue, vaults, and oracles. A separate infrastructure/API team manages backend services and the public API. The Head of Engineering will lead this off-chain group and help scale engineering practices.


Technology Stack and Culture

Morpho emphasizes security, minimalism, and modern DevOps:

On-chain: Solidity (Morpho Blue is ~600 LOC), fully audited, formally verified, $2.5M bug bounty

Off-chain: TypeScript (Node.js), Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GraphQL API

Dev Culture: Research-driven, collaborative, with open discussion and weekly “DeFi School” sessions

Engineers are encouraged to deeply threat-model and simplify systems. Most work is remote-friendly with periodic in-person bootcamps.

Recent Updates (Past 12 Months)

Corporate Restructuring: Morpho Labs SAS merged into the Morpho Association nonprofit; all equity transferred to the DAO.

Coinbase Partnership: Coinbase launched on-chain lending powered by Morpho on Base.

Token Unlock: MORPHO governance token became transferable in late 2024.

Growth: Deposits have scaled to ~$6 B; ongoing protocol upgrades and mobile features released.


Open Source and Community Contributions

Morpho’s contracts and tools are open source under a dual license. The GitHub organization hosts:

Morpho Blue (core protocol)

Vaults, oracles, and rewards contracts

TypeScript SDKs for integration

Developer documentation and tooling

They also regularly publish lending protocol research and offer one of the largest bug bounties in DeFi.

Locations and Remote Policy


Morpho Labs is based in Paris, with a remote-friendly culture. Team members work across Europe and North America (GMT-5 to GMT+2 time zones). Roles are open to remote engineers with occasional meetups at the Paris HQ.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Execution Team- Hashgraph

jobsdetail.description:
About Hashgraph:


Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera is EVM-compatible and has been specifically built to meet the needs of enterprise and Web3 applications, which require speed, security, stability and sustainability. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralised platform.


About The Team:


The Execution Team is one of the core teams that builds and maintains the Hiero Consensus Node, the heart of the Hiero Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). Our team is responsible for delivering the Hiero native services, which include the Crypto, Token, Consensus, and File Services. We also own transaction processing, fee collection, rewards accounting, and distribution. Furthermore, the generation of records and blocks is part of our responsibility. Our team works primarily in Java, and our code is open source. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to deliver a reliable, performant, scalable, secure, fault-tolerant, and developer-friendly platform.


About the role:


As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be a technical leader on the Execution Team, responsible for delivering software services, business logic, and APIs within the Hiero Consensus Node. You’ll work on deeply technical challenges involving distributed execution, state management, transaction lifecycles, and economic systems (fees, rewards, and penalties). You will work in a highly collaborative environment where innovation, trust, and ownership are key values. This is a high-impact role requiring deep passion for building the platform that powers next-generation decentralised applications.


You may find yourself doing all of the following:

Design, develop, test and debug core components of the execution layer

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver end-to-end functionality

Optimize performance and scalability of the execution layer for high-throughput transaction workloads

Ensure correctness, determinism, and reliability in service implementations

Drive high standards in code quality, testing, and documentation

Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and open-source collaboration

Conduit is seeking a Director of Banking Sales to drive commercial growth by selling our cross-border payments and infrastructure solutions to banks, including Tier 1 institutions to regional and community banks. This is a senior, high-impact role for someone who understands how banks operate, has a strong existing network across the U.S. banking ecosystem, and can independently generate new opportunities and relationships.


You’ll lead the go-to-market strategy for the banking segment - creating compelling sales materials, building tailored solution proposals, and working hand-in-hand with product, compliance, and engineering teams to design and implement bespoke cross-border payment flows. This role combines strategic sales leadership with technical and operational fluency, ideal for someone who can sell to banks and speak their language.


We’re looking for a builder: someone entrepreneurial, execution-oriented, and equally comfortable in a boardroom with banking c-suite as in the weeds with a payments operations team.


Key Responsibilities


Own the banking sales pipeline: Build and manage a robust pipeline of bank relationships across Tier 1, regional, and community banks. Drive the full sales lifecycle from outreach to closing.

Develop strategic relationships: Leverage your existing network to establish and expand partnerships that enable Conduit’s global cross-border payment flows.

Design and present solutions: Create compelling commercial proposals and payment flow structures aligned with each bank’s technical, compliance, and operational frameworks.

Lead sales enablement: Develop and refine sales collateral, pitch decks, and product positioning to effectively communicate Conduit’s value to financial institutions.

Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with compliance, legal, product, and engineering to ensure proposed solutions align with regulatory and operational requirements.

Guide onboarding and implementation: Partner with internal teams to ensure smooth bank integration, onboarding, and go-live processes, with a focus on client satisfaction and retention.

Drive outbound business development: Proactively identify and pursue new banking relationships — you’ll be expected to build and manage your own outbound pipeline.

Represent Conduit externally: Attend industry events, conferences, and client meetings to enhance Conduit’s visibility within the U.S. and global banking and fintech ecosystem.

• Architect and scale document ingestion and processing pipelines to power fast, accurate search, summarisation and data extraction over large volumes of legal documents.

• Design and implement intelligent, multi-step agent workflows that can autonomously handle complex legal tasks – from surfacing key testimony to generating fact chronologies and spotting inconsistencies in filings.

• Design and bring to life intuitive, AI-native user experiences tailored to litigation workflows, in partnership with the founders and early customers.

About the Company

Company Overview

Company Size: 5-10

Industry: AI-powered legaltech for litigation; software development

Specialties: Litigation, arbitration, dispute resolution, legal technology, and artificial intelligence

Founded: 2024

Headquarters: London, United Kingdom

Total Funding: US$500k+ pre-seed (Y Combinator and other investors; YC X25 batch)

https://www.crimson.law/


Our Mission

Crimson is an AI productivity platform built for litigators. Litigation teams use Crimson to analyze case files, answer case-specific questions and draft documents tailored to each dispute. By automating manual workflows across the life cycle of a case, Crimson helps lawyers find key evidence faster, streamline case management and save 10+ hours per week on common litigation tasks.


Company Culture


Crimson is a small, high-ownership team of three co-founders with deep technical and disputes expertise. They’re building a category-defining AI platform for high-stakes litigation, working with major UK and US law firms that trust them with highly sensitive case files. The culture is product-driven and security-obsessed: engineers talk directly to users, own features end-to-end, and care deeply about accuracy, reliability and speed. Backed by Y Combinator and other top investors, the team is focused on shipping quickly, learning from demanding users and setting a new standard for legal AI.


What you can expect

Day to Day

You’ll spend most of your time designing, building, and operating the full-stack systems that power Crimson’s AI platform for high-stakes litigation. Your work ships quickly to elite UK and US law firms and is used on live cases within days.


In practice, that looks like:


Contributing across the stack – from Python backend and document pipelines to Next.js + TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL, and Azure-hosted LLM workloads (with IaC + CI/CD).

Collaborating directly with litigators and knowledge workers to understand how they run disputes today, where the bottlenecks are, and how Crimson can slot into their workflows.

Designing and scaling ingestion, search and summarisation pipelines over large volumes of pleadings, transcripts, evidence, and orders.

Building intelligent, multi-step agent workflows that automate complex legal tasks, while keeping humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.

Iterating rapidly based on user feedback – instrumenting features, debugging real cases, and improving reliability and performance as more firms and matters come onto the platform.

Team

You’ll join a small, senior founding team that blends deep AI expertise with top-tier litigation experience.


Crimson was founded by Amine Amor (ML/AI specialist), David Strömbäck (AI engineer), and Mark Feldner (former BigLaw litigator).

You’ll work day-to-day with the technical founders on architecture, roadmap, and implementation, and partner closely with Mark to understand how litigators actually use the product in high-stakes cases.

The team is small, high-ownership, and product-driven – everyone ships code, talks to users, and has a strong voice in what gets built next.

Growth

This is a founding-level role with a lot of surface area and real upside:


Own major parts of Crimson’s architecture and product from day one and shape how the core litigation platform evolves over the coming years.

Help define engineering culture from scratch – everything from code standards and observability to how we run interviews and onboard future engineers.

Build deep relationships with elite UK and US law firms and see your work used on complex, cross-border disputes that matter.

Grow into a tech lead / founding-team engineering leader as the company scales – with meaningful equity in a YC-backed, category-defining legal AI company.


Interview Process

Intro Call (30 min) – Introductory conversation with one of the founders to learn more about your background, walk through Crimson’s product and users, and assess mutual fit.

Technical Deep Dive (60–75 min) – Live discussion with a founder covering your experience building and shipping full-stack products, system-design style questions, and how you’ve handled complex, real-world requirements.

Practical Exercise / Case Study (60–90 min) – Short take-home or live exercise focused on how you’d design and implement a Crimson-style feature (for example, a document ingestion + search workflow or an AI-assisted litigation task), followed by a review with the team.

Founder Round (60–90 min) – Conversations with the founding team to go deeper on collaboration style, product thinking, and mission alignment, plus any remaining technical topics.

Recruiting Tips

They're looking for someone who can quickly get up to speed, take ownership, and execute effectively with minimal oversight.

Currently, they operate perpetual markets on the Reya Network to provide liquidity. The next phase of their journey is to build a roll-up–based infrastructure on Ethereum, designed specifically for internet scale capital markets. Their goal is to address many of the structural inefficiencies of traditional finance by leveraging crypto.

This means building a system with sub-millisecond block times, near-zero trading fees, and seamless integration with Ethereum - bringing real-world assets and institutional-grade capital markets fully on-chain.


Senior DevOps Engineer – Reya Labs

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers the Reya DeX and Network. Your mission is to ensure our systems are secure, scalable, and highly available — enabling the team to deliver quickly without sacrificing reliability.

We're a dynamic, forward-thinking, fully remote team with an ambitious roadmap and a relentles drive to make things happen.

The ideal candidate is someone who loves automation, reliability engineering, infrastructure design, security, and performance. If you're a highly skilled DevOps engineer with over eight years of experience in infrastructure and CI/CD systems — and a commitment to security, observability, and operational excellence — we want to hear from you.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Design & Automation:

Design, implement, and maintain cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Build scalable, reproducible environments that support high-throughput, low-latency trading systems.

CI/CD & Developer Experience:

Own and improve the CI/CD pipelines for backend, frontend, and smart contract codebases. Ensure fast, reliable builds and deployments with strong observability and rollback mechanism.

Monitoring, Observability & Reliability:

Define and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies to achieve maximum system reliability and early incident detection. Drive SLO/SLI/SLAs and participate in on-call rotations.

Scalability & Performance:

Optimize infrastructure for latency-sensitive workloads. Tune autoscaling policies, network configurations, and resource utilization to ensure consistent performance during peak loads.

Security & Compliance:

Implement robust security practices across infrastructure, CI/CD, and runtime environments. Protect systems from evolving threats through network segmentation, secret management, and runtime hardening.

Incident Response & Disaster Recovery:

Establish and maintain playbooks, failover mechanisms, and disaster recovery plans. Lead post-incident reviews and proactively address root causes.

Cost Management:

Continuously monitor and optimize cloud costs while ensuring performance and redundancy requirements are met.

Technological Evaluation:

Stay current on infrastructure tooling, orchestration frameworks, and security best practices. Evaluate new technologies for potential adoption to improve performance and resilience.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:

Maintain clear, detailed documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbooks. Mentor engineers and help foster a culture of reliability and automation across the team.

Description

About Rain

At Rain, we’re rebuilding the global financial pipes money flows through. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real world by powering credit card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial system, we’d love to talk.

Our Ethos

Operating at the epicenter of stablecoin innovation means moving fast and thinking globally. Our team reflects the diverse, international audiences we serve. We hire people who stay agile as the tide ebbs and flows, fix what’s broken without waiting, chase trends before they peak, and remember to have fun through it all.


About the Role


We’re looking for Rain’s first dedicated Data Engineer—a hands-on builder who will architect the ingestion, pipelines, and infrastructure that power our data ecosystem. As Rain scales to millions of end users across payments, card programs, and blockchain rails, your systems will ensure every team has access to timely, accurate, and trustworthy data.


Reporting to the CTO and partnering closely with Analytics, Operations, Product, Compliance, and BD, you will own Rain’s data pipelines end-to-end: from ingesting raw transaction and blockchain data, to orchestrating transformations, to ensuring quality, observability, and reliability. This role is foundational—you’ll be shaping the data backbone that underpins analytics, customer reporting, operational tooling, and on-chain integrations.


If you love building in fast-moving environments, care deeply about data quality, and want to own core infrastructure at the heart of a modern fintech, this role is for you.


What You'll Do

Design, build, and maintain Rain’s core data pipelines, including ingestion from payments processors, card issuers, blockchain nodes, internal services, and third-party APIs.

Own orchestration and workflow management, implementing Airflow, Dagster, or similar tools to ensure reliable, observable, and scalable data processing.

Architect and manage Rain’s data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift), driving performance, cost optimization, partitioning, and access patterns.

Develop high-quality ELT/ETL transformations to structure raw logs, transactions, ledgers, and on-chain events into clean, production-grade datasets.

Implement data quality frameworks and observability (tests, data contracts, freshness checks, lineage) to ensure every dataset is trustworthy.

Partner closely with backend engineers to instrument new events, define data contracts, and improve telemetry across Rain’s infrastructure.

Support Analytics and cross-functional teams by delivering well-modeled, well-documented tables that power dashboards, ROI analyses, customer reporting, and key business metrics.

Own data reliability at scale, leading root-cause investigations, reducing pipeline failures, and building monitoring and alerting systems.

Evaluate and integrate new tools across ingestion, enrichment, observability, and developer experience—raising the bar on performance and maintainability.

Help set the long-term technical direction for Rain’s data platform as we scale across new products, regions, and chains.

New role live with Raiku! Candidates must be Solana native and worked on runtime, scheduler or other core systems on Solana - please ensure that the candidate githubs are active


About Raiku

Raiku is reengineering blockchain infrastructure from first principles to make global digital markets as precise and dependable as physical systems. Built on Solana, our platform delivers deterministic execution, guaranteed inclusion, and low-latency performance—solving the foundational failures that cause transactions to miss, trades to revert, and systems to collapse under pressure. By placing high-performance compute close to where transactions happen and coordinating execution through our advanced scheduling engine, Raiku empowers developers to build scalable, high-performance applications—and gives institutions the reliability and control they demand. We believe financial infrastructure should behave like physics: fast, reliable, and predictable—every time, without exception.


The Role

As a Senior Validator Engineer at Raiku, you will spearhead our engineering efforts surrounding the Solana Validator (both Agave and Firedancer), driving the innovation and implementation of next-generation high-performance distributed systems. You will work with a highly proficient team of core engineers who have all contributed to foundational and novel network components.


We believe in hiring only exceptional individuals who are highly motivated to work on complex core infrastructure challenges and are motivated by a coherent system design philosophy that will drive our industry forward. Expect frequent group discussions on architecture, new design specs and code reviews. We are all deeply committed to frequently shipping quality code.


About the Engineering Team

As a team, we are building an entire platform written in Rust, which connects the L1 and L2s and allows us to create deeply complex scenarios and interactions with the running network. While your primary focus for this role is Rust and complex interactions with different components, you may also be involved with other types of development, including exposure to the C-coded Firedancer validator. Working at every level of the stack is necessary to understand the big picture and how everything is wired together.


Responsibilities:

Highly motivated to contribute to our mission and be part of something bigger. Excited to work on projects that are ground-breaking and complex

Refactor, improve and lead software design and implementation

Communicate effectively with the team and document your code. It is also expected that senior engineers mentor less experienced engineers.

Read and understand protocol specifications and be able to break them into issues and turn them into code.

Maintaining a large codebase with many components and keeping it well-designed, future-proofed, modular and highly performant

Automate security testing processes and benchmarks, creating innovative tools and frameworks for continuously improving our systems.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you’ll own the reliability, quality, and performance of Stan’s data pipelines and integrations. You’ll build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers analytics, decision-making, and AI products used by thousands of creators. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operating under real ownership — keeping systems running, fixing what breaks, and designing infrastructure that scales.


Key Responsibilities

Own the health, reliability, and performance of production data pipelines across the company.

Build, maintain, and debug ETL/ELT pipelines feeding analytics, AI systems, and internal tools.

Ensure data quality, monitoring, and alerting so issues are caught early and fixed fast.

Design and maintain integrations across the data stack (APIs, warehouses, orchestration, downstream consumers).

Support and extend AI and agentic systems by building robust data and context pipelines.

Partner closely with data science, product, and engineering to enable data-driven decision-making.

Proactively improve infrastructure to prevent failures and scale with the business.

Job Overview

As a Senior Solutions Engineer focused on Integrations & AI Deployments, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing complex customer integrations across systems like HCM, LMS, and CRM. With a strong background in working with REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, and integration platforms such as Workato, you'll ensure deployments are not only reliable and secure but also scalable and maintainable. Acting as the technical lead for high-impact enterprise go-lives, you'll expand and strengthen our platform's APIs, developing repeatable, template-based integrations. This role requires you to define integration patterns, develop tooling, maintain documentation, and establish best practices for quicker deployment using reusable frameworks. Additionally, you will partner with our product and engineering teams to influence key roadmap decisions. In collaboration with enterprise customers, you will deploy AI-powered needs analysis, mapping required datasets and validating data quality while designing guardrails for AI outputs to ensure accuracy and compliance. Your implementations will seamlessly integrate into each organization, reflecting your ability to deliver native-feeling systems. With a base in the US and work authorization, you should have over six years of experience in Solutions Engineering or similar roles, and a proven track record of end-to-end ownership of complex integrations. Strong API and data pipeline expertise are crucial, complemented by your ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. With a compensation range of $200,000 to $220,000 per year, this role presents an exciting opportunity to contribute to and grow within a high-growth AI startup.

Responsibilities

1. Own Complex Customer Integrations

Design and implement integrations across HCM, LMS, CRM, and related enterprise systems

Work with REST APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, and integration platforms (e.g., Workato)

Ensure deployments are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy for customers to maintain

Act as technical lead for high-impact enterprise go-lives

2. Build & Productize Arist’s Integration Surface

Expand and harden Arist’s APIs to support repeatable, template-based integrations

Define integration patterns, tooling, documentation, and best practices

Reduce time-to-deployment through reusable frameworks

Partner with product and core engineering to influence roadmap decisions

3. Deploy AI Needs Analysis in Real Environments

Work directly with enterprise customers to deploy AI-powered needs analysis

Map required datasets and validate data quality

Design guardrails for AI outputs (accuracy, safety, compliance)

Deliver implementations that feel native inside each organization

jobsdetail.other:
Additional Information

This is a high-visibility, customer-facing role where you’ll work directly with enterprise clients to deploy and shape cutting-edge AI systems in real environments. You won’t just “support integrations” — you’ll own deployments that directly impact revenue, retention, and product adoption.

Arist is at an inflection point. The platform is already trusted by major global organizations, and demand for AI-powered enablement is accelerating. We are investing heavily in making our integrations and AI needs-analysis systems more scalable, repeatable, and enterprise-ready — and this role is central to that effort.

You will operate with significant autonomy and ownership. We value engineers who think in systems, write clearly, move quickly, and take responsibility for outcomes — not just output.

We are actively interviewing and will move quickly for strong candidates.

There's been an important update regarding the Senior Solutions Engineer – Integrations & AI Deployments role with Arist:

We’re looking for a strong, hands-on Solutions Engineer who leans more toward real implementation than sales engineering, with proven experience owning and shipping production-grade API integrations end to end, repeatedly standing up the same integrations across multiple customers, and optimizing for long-term stability, reliability, and maintainability, not just quick PoCs or prototypes; the ideal profile comes from enterprise B2B SaaS, is comfortable working closely with customers on integrations without becoming a project manager, and can move fast to implement, debug, and harden integrations in real-world environments.

jobsdetail.description:
About the Role

This is a rare opportunity to step in as Shoplift’s first VP of Product and own the full product function end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, team, and outcomes. You’ll help scale the company from founder-led product motion into a disciplined, high-performing product organization, defining what “self-optimizing storefronts” means for modern ecommerce. The mandate is clear: build the systems, team, and product-led growth engine that drives retention, expansion, and category leadership.

Shoplift does not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

🔑 Key responsibilities

Product Strategy, Vision, & Direction

Define and communicate a clear long-term product vision aligned with company strategy. Set direction for what we build, why it matters, and how it differentiates us in the market. Translate strategy into a coherent roadmap that balances innovation, merchant needs, and business priorities. Ensure all product teams are aligned around a shared understanding of goals, success measures, and tradeoffs.

Product Organization Leadership

Build, scale, and lead the entire product function—not just PMs, but the systems, rituals, and processes that make product excellent. Establish hiring philosophy, planning cadence, decision frameworks, and accountability mechanisms.

Product Management

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of the product from roadmap definition to delivery and iteration. Ensure high-quality execution, reliable delivery, and measurable adoption of new capabilities. Balance innovation and operational excellence by prioritizing impact, speed, and quality in all releases. Establish clear product process: how we prioritize, how decisions get made, what "definition of done" means. Make hard tradeoffs between new capabilities and technical debt.

Product Positioning

Own how the product competes and wins in the market. Conduct ongoing market research to understand the competitive landscape, platform trends, feature differentiation, and pricing models. Define and evolve pricing and packaging strategies that align with merchant value, product usage patterns, and business growth goals. Ensure the product’s value proposition, positioning, and monetization model are cohesive and inform go-to-market alignment.

Product Analytics

Define how success is measured for every product initiative. Ensure product analytics systems are instrumented correctly and insights flow into decision-making. Partner with Data and Growth to quantify product performance, usage patterns, and merchant impact.

Product Merchandising

Ensure the right features are discoverable, understood, and adopted. Drive in-product communication, feature activation, and cross-sell/upsell experiences that surface value to merchant at the right time.

Product-Led Growth (PLG)

Build self-serve growth loops into the product experience. Design shareable, viral, or usage-based mechanisms (e.g., shareable reports, feature unlocks) that drive organic adoption and expansion. Collaborate with Marketing and Growth to align PLG efforts with overall revenue strategy.

Product Documentation

Own the quality and completeness of product guides, tutorials, and help content. Ensure documentation is clear, up to date, and supports both onboarding and self-serve merchants.

Product Stickiness

Drive product stickiness and expansion through value realization and engagement. Design experiences that make the product indispensable increasing usage depth and multi-feature adoption. Partner with Growth Teams to identify product signals of expansion or churn risk, and prioritize roadmap initiatives that strengthen NDR.

Customer Empathy

Own our customer feedback loops. Ensure every feature is grounded in deep understanding of how ecommerce operators accelerate their success—their workflows, pain points, friction, and aspirations.

Support Experience & Systems

Own the support experience as an internal product: scoped, prioritized, and maintained with rigor. Partner with Engineering & Customer Success to ensure systems and processes meet internal SLAs. Build clear visibility into support data and patterns so product teams can identify recurring issues, quantify friction, and prioritize fixes or improvements in the roadmap.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Work closely with Engineering, Success, Sales, and Marketing. Partner with co-founder Jason Boit (Head of Product Experience) to ensure design and architecture amplify product strategy.

Metrics & Outcomes

Own key business outcomes: retention, engagement depth, net dollar retention. Connect product bets to measurable impact.
jobsdetail.benefits:
About the Company

Ecommerce brands face rising acquisition costs and intense competition, yet many still make key merchandising and pricing decisions without testing what actually converts. The gap between guessing and knowing can drive 15–30% differences in revenue, but traditional A/B testing has been too slow or complex for most merchants.

Shoplift is the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify. They help brands quickly identify what drives conversion using visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.

Trusted by 2,000+ brands—from high-growth DTC companies to Shopify Plus merchants—Shoplift pairs a powerful product with deep Shopify partnerships and a Customer Success team focused on delivering real business outcomes.

Shoplift is built by operators who value speed, ownership, and execution. They move fast, iterate often, and expect work that directly impacts revenue.

jobsdetail.description:
Important: Please read the following before referring candidates

They are hiring remotely across EMEA but potentially open to other locations, provided candidates are willing to work overlapping hours with the EU (this is a must).

Previous experience in Web3/DeFi is required developers

Li.Fi is simplifying multi-chain DeFi for traditional financial institutions, fintechs and service providers by offering a unified API to access all on-chain liquidity across major blockchains for best price same-chain and cross-chain swaps. We are a passionate team on a mission to enable a fairer, more decentralised world. Apart from the tech, we care a lot about user experience and aim to make complex technologies accessible to everyone.

A quick run-down of the job

We are looking for multiple Senior Backend Engineers who will lead the design, development, and maintenance of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high-quality software solutions that drive our success. The position will report to our Backend Lead.

The current tech stack of LI.FI utilizes:

Node.js running TypeScript code in Docker containers

MongoDB and Redis for our data

ethers.js for communication with the blockchains

Github, Kubernetes, AWS and CloudFlare for our GitOps CD chain

Please note: You must be located in the EMEA or APAC regions and have technical understanding of blockchain. Your application will not be considered otherwise.

What you'll do

Leading and actively participating in the design, development, and maintenance of backend systems and APIs

Architecting and implementing scalable and robust backend solutions that can handle growing user loads and evolving business needs

Maintaining high coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensuring best practices for code maintainability and readability

Identifying bottlenecks and optimizing code and algorithms to improve system performance

Implementing monitoring and debugging tools to proactively identify and resolve issues, ensuring high system availability

Developing and maintaining comprehensive test suites, including unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests, to ensure the reliability of backend systems

Providing guidance and mentorship to junior developers, helping them grow their technical skills

Analyzing complex technical problems and propose effective solutions to address them

Documenting code, APIs, and technical processes to facilitate knowledge sharing within the team and support onboarding of new developers

About LI.FI

Berlin-based LI.FI is providing a bridge between different blockchains, enabling developers to navigate a wide range of decentralised finance (DeFi) applications across multiple chains. The platform provides an application programme interface (API) that developers can build on to create prototypes and go to market faster.

The arrival of LI.FI comes at a time when DeFi has reemerged as a trending topic in the world of crypto, after the collapse of the centralised crypto exchange FTX. The resurgence of DeFi seems to provide a far more sustainable, scalable, and transparent crypto economy.

Backed by crypto-native investment firms CoinFund and Superscrypt, LI.FI is now in a prime position to execute its long term strategy of bringing more users to the world of Web3, by enabling tokens and orders to trade across any chain seamlessly.

LI.FI is simplifying multi-chain DeFi for traditional financial institutions, fintechs and service providers by offering a unified API to access all on-chain liquidity across major blockchains for best price same-chain and cross-chain swaps.

About Ostium Labs

Ostium is the first perpetuals DEX engineered specifically for Real World Assets. We build on the massive growth in on-chain perpetuals, bringing a first-of-its-kind twist through a focus on RWAs. Ostium will enable trading of an entirely new set of assets, previously unavailable on-chain — from gold & copper to wheat, oil, & forex pairs — to the most popular product in DeFi. How? Through trade execution at prices fed in via Chainlink’s new Functions product, a semi self-service oracle enabling low-latency feeds for long tail assets. We’re on track to be the first project to launch on Mainnet using Functions for settlement. A collective liquidity pool takes on counterparty risk during periods of open interest imbalance. We won the Pyth prize at xHack in October, were incubated by DeFi Alliance, and just raised 3.5M in seed funding. Our team is led by Harvard grads with prior experience at Bridgewater, IOI, IMO, and IPhO medalists, and lead engineers for Maple Finance and 21Shares. Benefits 2-4 annual company retreats (Europe & US), flexible hours, option for fully remote work.

jobsdetail.description:
Description

Alliance is the leading accelerator for crypto founders. Since 2020 we’ve backed 300+ startups (Pump, Synthetix, Pendle, Believe, and many more), now collectively valued at $10B+.

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our in-house engineering team. You’ll report directly to  (CTO) and will be responsible for owning features from the requirements definition stage to production.

What you’ll do

  • Own products end-to-end: discovery → definition → design/UX → implementation → launch → iteration.
  • Write production-grade TypeScript across the stack (React/Next.js on the front-end; Node.js on the back-end) while following best practices.
  • Build and maintain internal tools that make our team faster.
  • Ship features across our external sites and webapps, including Space – our founder portal – and public marketing surfaces.
  • Craft polished UIs with React and our internal component library; contribute components and patterns back to the library.
  • Integrate third-party APIs (auth, payments, email) and own data models, caching, and performance.
  • Raise the bar on engineering quality: code reviews, CI/CD, reliability, and accessibility.
jobsdetail.requirement:
What we’re looking for

  • Product-minded builder who can turn ambiguous problems into shipped software without a dedicated PM or designer.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js; familiarity with Next.js and a modern database (e.g., Postgres/Prisma) is a plus.
  • Taste for UX/UI and the ability to sketch flows or lightweight wireframes before coding.
  • Hands-on IC orientation with a strong ownership bias: you set priorities, move fast, and sweat details.
  • Extremely high-agency, entrepreneurial, self-driven.
  • Comfortable using modern AI tools to move faster.
  • NYC-based or willing to relocate (non-negotiable).

Examples of strong qualifications (good to have but not required)

  • Standout GitHub: notable open-source projects, meaningful contributions, or traction.
  • Design-engineering portfolio showing polished UI work, component systems, and attention to accessibility/performance.
  • Founder or early team member of a VC-backed startup that raised millions in funding.
  • SWE at Meta, Stripe, OpenAI, or another category-defining tech company.
  • Clear signals of exceptional ability: competitive gaming/esports (chess, MtG, StarCraft), Math/Physics Olympiad medalist, top academic background (Harvard/Stanford/MIT), professional sports athlete, etc.

jobsdetail.description:
Who We Are

Baton Corporation is the development company behind pump.fun, the dominant memecoin launchpad on Solana, processing $750M+ in daily trading volume. Over the last 2 years, pump.fun generated $950M+ in revenue with a team of fewer than 100 people.

We operate at real scale. The systems we build are used by hundreds of thousands of users, and the changes we ship reach production daily—sometimes within hours.

How We Work

  • We ship to production every day
  • We keep bureaucracy low and ownership high
  • Engineers own their platforms end-to-end
  • Decisions are data-driven and guided by experimentation

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Payments Platforms Engineer to own and scale the infrastructure backbone that powers our fiat <-> crypto payment flows. This is not a pure DevOps or SRE role — you'll be a senior technical contributor who designs cloud-native platforms, defines engineering standards, and directly enables the product and engineering teams shipping the next generation of our payments infrastructure.

You'll bring deep experience from a neobank, payment service provider, or financial institution — somewhere like Monzo, GoCardless, Wise, Checkout.com, Adyen, Stripe, Revolut, or a tier-1 bank's payments division — where you've had to make cloud infrastructure reliable, scalable, and compliant under real-world financial constraints.

What You'll Build & Own

As a Payments Platforms Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the cloud and infrastructure layer that underpins our entire payments stack. You'll work closely with our backend payments engineers, compliance team, and security function to ensure our systems are resilient, auditable, and production-grade.

You will:

  • Architect and operate our AWS-based payments infrastructure — multi-region, highly available, and designed with financial-grade resilience (active-active or active-passive failover, RTO/RPO commitments, disaster recovery runbooks).
  • Own our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) estate using Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK — full lifecycle management of AWS resources including VPCs, EKS/ECS clusters, RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, and API Gateway.
  • Design and enforce network security architecture for a regulated payments environment: private subnets, VPC peering/PrivateLink for third-party integrations (Plaid, Stripe, Chainalysis, etc.), WAF rules, Shield Advanced, and robust ingress/egress controls.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support safe, high-frequency production deployments across our payments services — including blue/green and canary releases, automated rollback, and deployment gating tied to SLO compliance.
  • Define and operate our secrets and key management strategy — AWS KMS, Secrets Manager, HSM integration where required for PCI DSS scope, and robust secret rotation practices.
  • Own observability infrastructure — centralised logging (CloudWatch, OpenSearch or equivalent), distributed tracing (AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry), metrics pipelines, and alerting that surfaces real payment failures, latency spikes, and compliance-relevant anomalies to on-call engineers.
  • Platform compliance and audit readiness — design infrastructure controls that satisfy PCI DSS, SOC 2, and relevant FCA/regulatory expectations: immutable audit logs, access controls, data residency, encryption at rest and in transit, and evidence generation for auditors.
  • Manage data platform infrastructure for our payments data — RDS Aurora PostgreSQL (primary OLTP, event streaming MSK/Kafka or Kinesis), and integration with any analytical stores used for reconciliation and reporting.
  • Build reliability tooling — SLO/SLA dashboards, automated runbooks, chaos engineering experiments, and load/stress test harnesses for critical payment paths.
  • Own disaster recovery and backup strategy — design and test multi-region failover, define RTO/RPO targets per service tier, build automated backup pipelines, and maintain runbooks for full and partial recovery scenarios. Ensure business continuity is provable, not assumed.
  • Drive platform cost engineering — rightsizing, Reserved/Savings Plans, Spot strategy for non-payment-critical workloads, and tagging taxonomy for financial allocation across products.
  • Support and mentor backend engineers on platform best practices — container packaging, 12-factor apps, environment parity, and safe use of managed AWS services.

jobsdetail.description:
Job Overview

Join our team as a pioneering Full-Stack Engineer, where innovation and rapid growth converge in the heart of San Francisco. As Engineer #1, you'll have the unique opportunity to work closely with our founders to craft cutting-edge AI-driven features that empower non-coders. Your role will involve engaging directly with users, dedicating time to understanding their needs, and translating these insights into seamless user experiences. Expect to ship full-stack features that serve as foundational building blocks for app creation, handling everything from storage and payments to authentication. Your strong full-stack expertise with React, TypeScript, and Node.js will be essential, alongside a proven track record of end-to-end feature implementation. With at least three years under your belt, you'll bring a fast yet meticulous approach to development, valuing both speed and quality in equal measure. In this role, you'll enhance our AI's runtime and improve prompt engineering, ensuring high-quality output in both functionality and design. Additionally, you'll be instrumental in building scalable infrastructure to support millions of apps. Your deep sense of ownership and product intuition will be vital as you take on the responsibility of driving features from concept to production. This is your chance to evolve from an initial engineering role into a tech lead capacity, contributing to shaping our technical direction and standards. If you thrive on innovation, enjoy tackling complex challenges head-on, and are excited by the potential for broad impact in an early-stage environment, this is the perfect opportunity to grow and make a lasting impact.

Responsibilities

  • Talk to users often to deeply understand how to improve Floot's AI and UX (you can expect to spend 10-20% of your time on support)
  • Ship full-stack features and build the foundational building blocks that users will use to build their apps seamlessly (e.g. storage, payments, auth, etc)
  • Improve our AI runtime to handle edge cases and make our agentic system more reliable
  • Prompt engineering and evals to improve AI output quality (for both function + design)
  • Build robust infrastructure for our end-to-end platform to power millions of production apps
jobsdetail.requirement:
Qualifications

  • Strong full-stack experience with React, TypeScript, and Node.js: you've shipped production features end-to-end
  • Atleast 3+ years of experience
  • Strong sense of ownership: you’re autonomous and own features from start to finish
  • Fast but thoughtful: you ship quickly without cutting corners on things that matter
  • Strong sense for UX and product polish: you believe that craft matters

Ideal Candidate

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Founding-engineer mindset – excited to build from zero and own large parts of the product
  • Full-stack engineer leaning either toward:
    • Infrastructure / backend (comfortable with AWS, backend systems, reliability), or
    • Frontend (design-engineer type or experience doing frontend framework-level work like rich text editors or contributing to React)
  • Strong at shipping product end-to-end – can take features from idea → implementation → production
  • Comfortable working in high ambiguity with fast iteration and changing priorities
  • Product-minded engineer – cares about UX, not just code quality
  • Enjoys working closely with founders and early users to shape the product
  • Values ownership, speed, and technical quality over process and hierarchy
  • Thrives in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and impact is high

Full-stack engineer with a clear strength in either:

  • Infrastructure, or
  • Frontend

For infra-leaning candidates:

  • Strong experience with AWS
  • Comfortable designing and operating production backend systems
  • Experience with scalability, reliability, and infra tooling

For frontend-leaning candidates:

  • Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks
  • Either:
    • A design-engineer profile (strong UI/UX + engineering), or
    • Experience working at the framework / platform level (e.g., building complex editors, contributing to React or similar tooling)

About Company

Floot is building the AI-first software foundation for non-coders to build and deploy full-stack web apps. We grew from 5 to 600+ paying customers during YC! 🚀 Unlike other platforms that cobble together dev tools, we're rebuilding the entire software stack for a world where AI writes most of the code. Launched as #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt, validating strong early demand and user interest.

Our goal: Make Floot the default choice for anyone to build and ship software.

Our founders are staff engineers from Retool and AWS. Edward (CTO) bootstrapped his last SaaS company to $5M+ ARR in one year

We've been working tirelessly to build the easiest and most powerful platform for non-coders & entrepreneurs to build serious web apps with AI. We're taking a new approach by designing everything from the ground up for AI.

Many non-coders today struggle with AI app builders and end up abandoning their projects. They often get stuck with errors they don't understand or need to wrestle with developer services not designed for them. This is because most vibe coding platforms just slap AI on top of existing developer tools.

Floot does things differently:

  1. We created a specialized framework that dictates how AI should write code and how the code runs on our infrastructure. This allows us to enforce best practices, detect errors earlier, and give the best feedback to the AI. As a result, Floot can write better code and fix issues more effectively.
  2. We built the entire tech stack into Floot (backend, database, hosting, etc) so building and managing an app feels seamless, especially for non-coders. And because we control every layer of the stack, we can optimize each layer for AI-first coding.

Because of this, our users say they can finally build what they want instead of getting stuck in frustrating error loops.

We also built a highly scalable hosting system directly on AWS so Floot apps can handle real traffic and business demands. This means non-coders can build, deploy, and scale their apps on a single platform seamlessly.

Company Culture

Floot’s culture reflects the values of a fast-moving, early-stage startup with a strong technical foundation and an AI-first mindset.

  • High ownership & impact – early hires own big parts of the product end-to-end
  • Strong technical bar – care deeply about clean systems and core infrastructure
  • Fast-moving & iterative – ship quickly, learn from real users, improve fast
  • Collaborative & low-ego – work closely across product and engineering
  • Builder-first mindset – obsessed with making it easier for others to build real products

What you can expect

Day to Day

As Engineer #1, you will work directly with the founders to build the product and shape our culture. You’ll wear many hats and touch everything from AI systems, user-facing features, to backend infrastructure.

Day-to-Day

  • Work directly with the founders to design and build core product features
  • Build and iterate on user-facing features used by early customers
  • Develop and maintain backend services and infrastructure supporting the platform
  • Work on AI systems and integrations that power the product experience
  • Take features from idea → implementation → production with high ownership
  • Rapidly prototype, ship, and refine based on user feedback
  • Help shape engineering best practices and contribute to the company culture
  • Jump across the stack as needed, wearing many hats in an early-stage environment

Team

Our founders are staff engineers from Retool and AWS. Edward (CTO) bootstrapped his last SaaS company to $5M+ ARR in one year.

  • Report directly to the founders
  • Work as Engineer #1, partnering closely with the founding team
  • Collaborate tightly with product and design through the founders
  • Help define early engineering standards, tooling, and culture

Growth

  • Opportunity to grow from Engineer #1 into a tech lead or founding engineering leader
  • Increasing ownership over core systems and architecture as the team scales
  • Chance to shape the engineering org, hiring bar, and technical direction early
  • Exposure to building and scaling AI-powered product infrastructure from the ground up
  • Clear path to broader responsibility across product, platform, and team leadership

Interview Process

  • 1st screening – Co-founder – 15–20 min
  • Live case
  • Culture fit – Founders + reference calls

Job Overview

In this role, you will be a key player on our go-to-market team as the first account executive, collaborating directly with our founders and GTM team to introduce an innovative search layer for AI agents to the market. You will drive the full sales cycle, which entails everything from initial outreach and discovery to product demo, negotiation, and successful closure of deals. Working with high-intent inbound leads from various segments such as AI, data, and enterprise, you will conduct engaging product demos and solutions sessions tailored for technical teams. A profound understanding of customer workflows is essential, as you will position our APIs and infrastructure as the cornerstone of their AI systems. Close collaboration with Product and Engineering colleagues will help you develop custom solutions and channel insights from the field. You are expected to develop repeatable sales strategies for AI-native and enterprise innovation teams, contribute to the GTM strategy, pricing, and messaging, and diligently track and report key metrics, such as pipeline development, win rate, and expansion potential. A background of 4+ years in B2B SaaS or technical sales, particularly in AI, developer tools, or data infrastructure, is required, along with experience engaging technical buyers, founders, CTOs, engineers, and data teams, using a consultative sales approach.

You’ll play a key role in bringing Linkup, the search layer for AI agents, to market, working with some of the most advanced teams in AI.

Your core responsibilities will be to:

  • Own the full sales cycle: from outreach and discovery to demo, negotiation, and close
  • Partner with high-intent inbound leads across AI, data, and enterprise segments
  • Run compelling product demos and solutioning sessions with technical teams
  • Understand customer workflows deeply and position Linkup’s APIs and infrastructure as the foundation for their AI systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to craft custom solutions and feed insights from the field
  • Build repeatable playbooks for selling to AI-native teams and enterprise innovation groups
  • Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing, and messaging based on market feedback
  • Track and report key metrics across pipeline, win rate, and expansion opportunities
